canDoYue: 你識講幾時常起身、開工、小休同埋收工。
canDoEn: Say when you usually wake up, start, take a break, and close.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: I usually wake up early, and then I start my long shift.
dialogue.glossYue: 我通常早起身，然後先開始返長更。
dialogue.say: I usually wake up early, and then I start my long shift.

dialogue.speaker: ling
dialogue.text: The shop is always open before our lunch.
dialogue.glossYue: 舖頭午餐之前一定開門。
dialogue.say: The shop is always open before our lunch.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: I sometimes take a short break after lunch.
dialogue.glossYue: 我有時午餐之後會小休一陣。
dialogue.say: I sometimes take a short break after lunch.

dialogue.speaker: ling
dialogue.text: I never finish the whole shift before then.
dialogue.glossYue: 我從來唔會喺嗰陣之前做完整更。
dialogue.say: I never finish the whole shift before then.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: We always close the shop after the night shift.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋每次夜更之後都關門。
dialogue.say: We always [[klˈoʊz]] the shop after the night shift.

understand.prompt: I usually wake up early, and then I start my long shift. 呢句即係點？
understand.explain: usually 係通常。then 係然後。

understand.prompt: The shop is always open before our lunch. 呢句即係點？
understand.explain: always 係每次。before 係之前。

understand.prompt: I sometimes take a short break after lunch. 呢句即係點？
understand.explain: sometimes 係有時。after 係之後。

chunks.pattern: The shop is always ___ before lunch.
chunks.example: The shop is always open before lunch.

chunks.pattern: I sometimes take a ___ after lunch.
chunks.example: I sometimes take a break after lunch.

chunks.pattern: We always ___ the shop after the shift.
chunks.example: We always close the shop after the shift.

sound.title: shift 同 lunch
sound.note: shift 開頭係 /ʃ/，舌面向後，氣由中間出。lunch 收尾係 /tʃ/，先頂住再送出。usually 入面有 /ʒ/，係 /ʃ/ 嘅有聲版。
